info.title: cyex.tv API
info.description: Emotes for Twitch and Kick. Public reads need no auth; writes need a cyex.tv session.

get.summary: The service can reach its database.

put.summary: Give an account a role. Audited.

delete.summary:
Take a role from an account. The owner and the last `roles.manage` holder are protected.
Audited.

post.summary: Sign out and end the session.

get.summary: Where the platform sends the browser back to.
get.description: Sets the session cookie and redirects to `return_to`.

400.description: Bad or expired `state`, or the user declined.

get.summary: Start signing in with Twitch or Kick.
get.description:
Redirects to the platform's consent page. With `link=true` and a signed-in session, the
identity is linked to the current account instead.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: Where to send the browser afterwards. Must be a cyex.tv URL.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link this platform to the signed-in account instead of signing in.

302.description: Redirect to the platform's sign-in page.

get.summary: A channel by its login or slug. Logins change; store the ID, not the login.
A channel by its platform ID.

404.description: `not_found`: no cyex.tv account has this channel.

patch.summary: Change a channel's active set and settings. Only the channel's owner.

post.summary:
Upload an emote. It starts `pending`: usable in your own sets, hidden from everyone else until a
moderator approves it.
post.description: PNG, APNG, GIF, WebP or AVIF; at most 5 MB, 1000×1000 px and 1000 frames.

get.summary: An emote. Pending ones are visible to their owner and to moderators only.

delete.summary: Delete your emote. It is removed from every set.

patch.summary: Change an emote's name, tags or flags. Owner, or `emotes.edit_any`.

get.description:
Served by the events service at the same host; listed here so the contract is in one document.

Event types:
- `set.emote_added`
- `set.emote_removed`
- `set.emote_renamed`
- `channel.active_set_changed`
- `personal.updated`
- `emote.updated`
- `resync`

Resume with `Last-Event-ID` (24 h window). A comment line arrives every 20 s.

delete.summary: Unlink a platform from the signed-in account. The last identity can't be removed.

post.summary: Reject an emote with a reason. Needs `emotes.review`. Audited.
Personal sets for up to 100 chatters at once, for clients rendering a chat.
Create a role. You can only grant permissions you hold. Audited.

delete.summary: Delete a role below your own highest one. Audited.

patch.summary: Change a role below your own highest one. Audited.

get.summary: Search approved, listed emotes by name and tag.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name or tag to look for.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Only emotes owned by this account ID.

post.summary: Create a channel set, or your personal set (one per account).

get.summary: The cyex.tv global set, shown in every channel.
A set with its emotes. Send `If-None-Match` to get `304` when nothing changed.

delete.summary: Delete a set. Owner only. A channel's active set can't be deleted.

patch.summary: Rename a set or change its capacity. Owner or editor; capacity needs `sets.edit_any`.

get.summary: The people who may edit a set besides its owner.

put.summary: Make someone an editor of a set. Owner only.

delete.summary: Remove an editor. Owner, or the editor themselves.

put.summary: Add an emote to a set. Personal sets take approved emotes only.

delete.summary: Remove an emote from a set.

patch.summary: Rename an emote in a set, or change its zero-width flag there.

AccountSummary.description: A short reference to an account, for owners and editors.

name.description: Rename it in this set. Defaults to the emote's own name.

allow_personal_emotes.description: Whether other people's personal emotes show in this channel.

platform_channel_id.description: Twitch: the broadcaster's user ID. Kick: `broadcaster_user_id`.

kind.description: `channel` or `personal`. The global set exists already.

EmoteFile.description: One file of an emote, served at `{host}/{name}`.

is_static.description: The first frame of an animated emote.

private.description: Only its owner can add it to sets.

ErrorBody.description: An error answer. `error` is a stable code clients can match on; `message` is for people.

Identity.description: A Twitch or Kick account linked to a cyex.tv account.

platform_user_id.description: The platform's numeric user ID, as text.

permissions.description: Permission names from the account's roles (ADR 0010).

user_ids.description: Up to 100 platform user IDs, for example the people seen in chat.

PersonalLookupResult.description: Only users with a non-empty personal set are listed.

position.description: Higher means more senior. You can only manage roles below your own highest one.

SetEmote.description: An emote as it sits in a set: the name it is typed as there, and who added it.

name.description: The name in this set. Differs from `emote.name` when the set renamed it.

capacity.description: Needs `sets.edit_any` to raise above the default.

UploadEmote.description: Multipart upload: the image file and its name.
